full_track.tags: K-Pop ballad with R&B influences. The arrangement features a delicate piano melody playing arpeggiated chords and a warm acoustic guitar strumming on the off-beats. A smooth electric bass provides melodic movement in the lower register. The drums consist of a soft kick and a crisp snare with light reverb. A male vocalist performs with a clean, emotive tone, utilizing a mix of chest voice and light vibrato. The tempo is approximately 75 BPM in the key of C Major. The production is polished with a wide stereo image for the acoustic instruments and centered vocals.
